# Frozen companyfacts for the re-tagged-leg pins

`tests/test_retagged_legs.py` reads these. They track NO page and are never regenerated by
`scripts/build_companyfacts_fixture.py`: each one freezes a real filer whose annual leg stopped on
every alias while the filer carried a candidate substitute (`vinci.edgar.concepts.SUBSTITUTES`)
— accepted or refused — (`docs/records/2026-10-27-a-retagged-annual-leg-is-read-from-its-new-tag.md`).

Cut 2026-10-27 from the shared SEC cache, unmodified apart from the tag subset. Each keeps every
alias (`CONCEPT_ALIASES`) of the concepts its pins read, revenue's aliases, and every substitute
tag of those concepts, in the exact companyfacts shape, `sort_keys` and `indent=1` like the other
frozen fixtures.

**Checked at cut time, against the full blob:** `annual_line`, `current_annual` and
`current_pair` return the same result on the subset, and the newest fiscal year
(`filer_fiscal_year`) ends on the same day and is named by the same tag.

| file | filer (CIK) | fetched | concepts kept | what it pins |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SMG.json` | Scotts Miracle-Gro (825542) | 2026-09-23 | operating income, D&A | split accepted: $80.6M at the FY2024 handover, FY2025 read |
| `CHH.json` | Choice Hotels (1046311) | 2026-08-13 | operating cash flow, capex | `PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPlantAndEquipment` accepted, FY2019 handover |
| `ECVT.json` | Ecovyst (1708035) | 2026-09-23 | operating income, D&A | split refused, 23% short |
| `GO.json` | Grocery Outlet (1771515) | 2026-08-13 | operating income, D&A | split refused, 1.63% short |
| `THO.json` | Thor Industries (730263) | 2026-09-23 | operating cash flow, capex | two tags 1.13% apart in one 10-K, refused |
| `PACB.json` | Pacific Biosciences (1299130) | 2026-08-13 | operating income, D&A | no year both carry, refused |
| `GSL.json` | Global Ship Lease (1430725) | 2026-08-13 | operating cash flow, capex | capital improvements ≠ capex, refused |
| `LNTH.json` | Lantheus (1521036) | 2026-08-13 | operating cash flow, capex | a zero ends the continuation |
| `DRH.json` | DiamondRock Hospitality (1298946) | 2026-08-13 | operating cash flow, capex | a missing year ends the continuation |
